answer: One defense is a willow identity: each agent's standing bends but never breaks - it must periodically re-prove itself with a fresh cipher, a short puzzle keyed to a public random seed that only an agent doing real work can solve in time. Each solved cipher is carved into an ivory record, a public append-only ledger of verified deeds that anyone can audit but no one can rewrite. A sybil farmer must solve a separate cipher and build a separate ivory history for every clone, paying fresh compute per fake, while one honest agent bends with the willow and keeps a single unbroken record.
